job: View a chat image full size and step through the others.
purpose: A large dialog that opens when a person clicks an image in a chat message. It shows the image, a counter such as 2 of 4, and Previous and Next buttons. chat.js creates one shared dialog for the page. It is a dialog with a media area, so it traps focus and closes on Escape.
useWhen: A chat message holds images and people should see them larger.

avoidWhen.when: Images in a gallery outside a chat.
A file that is not an image.

parts.role: The dialog; it is also an fd-dialog.
